name: Letty Lopez
office: City of West Covina, Member of the City Council, 2nd District

items.text: Letty Lopez-Viado is the mayor of West Covina, first elected to the city council in 2018. She is a senior director for the Los Angeles Department of Recreation and Parks and previously served on the city’s Community and Senior Services Commission. She sits on the boards of the Los Angeles County Sanitation Districts and Foothill Transit. Her city biography says she is committed to maintaining parks, strengthening public safety, supporting local businesses, and promoting fiscal stewardship and transparency. In 2025 she proposed censuring a councilman for alleged harassment; the council instead voted to open a third-party investigation into both members’ claims. The city won a 2026 federal court ruling; she said the decision reinforced a safe, respectful workplace.
